paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar Avina, [Shabbat 60b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.60b.12); Rabbi Elazar bar Avina, [Berakhot 4b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.4b.23); Rabbi Yaakov bar Avina, [Yerushalmi Shevuot 6:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shevuot.6.3.2); Shila bar Avina, [Avodah Zarah 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.22b.2); Rav Tachlifa bar Avina, [Chullin 60b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.60b.8-9).[^2]

notes.text: The consulted Avodah Zarah 22b distinguishes Rav Tachlifa from Rav Shela, through whom he reports. Hyman’s Shila has no title in this occurrence.

In Avodah Zarah, Rav Tachlifa transmits a teaching from Rav Shila bar Avina in the name of Rav. Chullin separately names Rav Tachlifa bar Avina. Heilprin lists [Shila bar Avina](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3290&lang=en) and [Tachlifa bar Avina](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3546&lang=en) separately.
